title: Tourists can finally see the Parthenon

paragraphs: The famous Parthenon in Greece is finally finished after a long restoration. Restorers took away all the construction tools, metal frames, and scaffolding from the western side.

Now, people can see the temple in its most complete form in over 200 years. Many tourists are very excited and happy about this change. Visitors who came last year remember a lot of building work, which blocked the beautiful view.

Now, the temple is clean and open. People can look at it from close by or from far away. Travelers say the Acropolis looks amazing and very beautiful without the construction things in front of it. It helps them imagine how the great building looked like a long time ago.

words.d: repairing an old building, painting, or object
a structure which workers use to repair a building
a special building where people go to show respect to their god or gods

paragraphs: Tourists visiting Athens are marveling at the Parthenon’s western pediment after restorers finally unveiled the ancient landmark. The temple is now visible in its most complete form in over 200 years.

For a long time, the iconic structure on top of the Acropolis was covered by heavy construction equipment, large metal frames, and scaffolding, which blocked the view for visitors. Now, with all the building materials finally removed, people can see the ancient monument from both close up and further away without any visual obstacles.

Visitors describe the newly uncovered temple as incredibly beautiful, special, and amazing. The complete view gives them a rare chance to see a little bit of how the historic building actually looked in the past. For many international travelers, seeing the clean, completed Acropolis fulfills a lifelong dream, with some even saying the majestic atmosphere makes it feel as though gods still live inside the building.

words.d: a large triangular part of a building in ancient Greek style, usually found above the entrance or columns
